_schema.description: Reviewed log of runs, keyed by date. One entry per day. Synced runs that are not in here yet still appear on the published pages, marked 'synced — not yet reviewed'; an entry here replaces that with the reviewed numbers and the athlete's own words.

fields.km: distance in km (0 for a deliberate rest / skipped day)
fields.pace: m:ss/km — may be followed by detail, e.g. '5:40/km · splits 5:45/5:38/...'
fields.comment: how it felt, in the athlete's own words or a faithful summary
fields.notes: objective flags worth surfacing: HR vs pace mismatch, niggles, trends
fields.session_type: optional override for the progress page: easy | quality | long
